verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence for getting data into Paperspace is a documented how-to for mounting datasets in Gradient Notebooks, which is a thin, title-only mention. Shared drives, unlimited bandwidth and SSH root access are adjacent features, not transfer tooling, and one hands-on report says copying datasets onto Core machines was very slow. missing for 10: S3-compatible endpoints, cloud-storage sync, documented bulk transfer tooling for Machines, data-out/export paths, any detail on dataset mounting sources, positive independent corroboration of transfer efficiency.

support.subject: As a developer, I can move data in and out efficiently — S3-compatible endpoints, cloud-storage sync, or documented transfer tooling
